subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Which Microsoft Teams Graph fallback policy should be the canonical fix for inbound channel/group attachments: unconditional plugin fallback, config-gated fallback, or a combined/narrowed version of the two open PRs?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but the open linked PRs encode different product tradeoffs around extra Graph message fetches, operator configuration, and preserving the prior protection against mention-only 404 diagnostics.

options.title: Merge one combined canonical fix
options.body: Review the two open PRs and land a single Teams plugin fix that includes the channel URL corrections plus a maintainer-approved fallback gate for stripped text/html activities.

options.title: Prefer default-on fallback
options.body: Use the non-config PR path if maintainers accept extra best-effort Graph lookups for non-personal Teams HTML stubs as the documented Graph media behavior.

options.title: Prefer config-gated fallback
options.body: Use the config-gated PR path if maintainers want upgrade behavior unchanged unless operators explicitly opt in to extra Graph lookups.

recommendation.title: Merge one combined canonical fix
recommendation.body: Review the two open PRs and land a single Teams plugin fix that includes the channel URL corrections plus a maintainer-approved fallback gate for stripped text/html activities.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available product-boundary routing candidate from the Microsoft Teams plugin migration history and config/plugin policy context.
